blocks.text: The census delivered measured evidence for 638 of 1006 tables across 6 connections. 513 tables had a complete pass, 83 a stratified sample and 41 a head sample. The run read 5.9m rows and 351.3 GiB of data and index in 15.5 minutes. The result receipt is digest-verified and the ledger shows the run completing as governed.

The delivery is partial. 3 connections completed, 2 were partial and 1 was blocked: artists_app, access denied, grant pending. 44 tables failed. The method counts do not sum exactly to 638, and we disclose that rather than repair it.

We recommend that the owner accepts the delivery as a documented partial record and holds the commission open. Closure should wait for the artists_app grant and re-census and for a re-run of the failed tables.
The exhibit splits tables by method: complete pass, stratified sample, head sample, failed and not reached. The largest group had a complete pass, which is the firmest evidence the census can give.
The categories do not reconcile with 1006 or 638, so we show them as supplied. No residual category has been added. The chart supports a statement about method, not a claim of exhaustive coverage.

blocks.caption: The categories do not reconcile with 1006 or 638, so read the chart as a split of method, not as proof of full coverage.

blocks.text: 638 of 1006 tables were measured. 513 had a complete pass, 83 a stratified sample and 41 a head sample. The measured scope is useful but not uniform in assurance.
The three method counts do not sum exactly to 638. Until that is reconciled, any coverage percentage should be treated as provisional, and we have not published one.

5.9m rows and 351.3 GiB of data and index were measured. The estate is estimated to hold 259.3m rows. That is an estimate of holdings and not a count of rows inspected, so the two should not be compared as coverage.
44 tables failed and remain unmeasured. The run took 15.5 minutes on the runtime. That is a duration, not a cost, and we draw no cost conclusion from it.
The exhibit shows the pattern by connection: complete connections, two partial ones and artists_app with nothing reached. It is a useful picture of where the gaps sit.
Its table counts total the tables in scope rather than the measured total of 638. The label says measured, so its definition needs clarifying before anyone quotes connection-level coverage from it.

blocks.caption: The series totals to the tables in scope, not to 638, so do not use it to claim measured coverage by connection until the definitions are resolved.

blocks.text: Measured data and index volume is concentrated in iebc_forms, which accounts for nearly all of the 351.3 GiB. The other connections hold comparatively little.
Concentration of storage is not completeness. artists_app plots at zero because it was blocked, so its holdings are unknown. Storage volume also says nothing about business value.

blocks.text: 3 of 6 connections completed, 2 were partial and 1 was blocked. 20 databases were measured. artists_app needs the owner to grant access and then a re-census. citizen_digital and citizen-pulse are partial because some of their tables failed.
Accepting the delivery does not remove these dependencies. They remain open whether or not the commission is closed.

The ledger holds 3 rows for the run, and the lawful basis admission is on file and covers the census only. Together with the digest-verified result receipt, this supports accountability for how the run was executed. It does not show that coverage is complete.

The executive dossier used 17679 tokens in and 4583 tokens out. A separate enumeration reached 106 object storage buckets, and 40 were unreachable. These are usage and listing figures, not cost or content inspection.

The owner's first step is to choose: accept the delivered scope of 638 of 1006 tables as a partial record, or hold closure. We recommend accepting the record while keeping the commission open. We do not propose acceptance criteria beyond those the owner sets.

Next, grant access on artists_app and commission a re-census. Then re-run the 44 failed tables once their recorded errors are fixed. Where firmer ratios are needed, run complete passes on the 83 stratified and 41 head-sampled tables. Finally, reconcile the count discrepancies before any coverage figure is quoted.

Blocked, failed and unreached areas are unknown. Ratios on sampled tables are indicative only. Languages, rights and semantic similarity were not measured. They close respectively through the artists_app grant and re-census, a complete-pass census, a re-run of the failed tables, and a language and similarity pass with rights declared at source.

Digest verification and ledger success establish that the run was governed and its result unaltered. They do not establish completeness, and closing the commission needs the owner's explicit acceptance of these limits.
